name: ROC curve (deprecated)
summary: Plot ROC-AUC curve for multi-LAP and multi-NN. Warning: this app can be run ONLY after the app https://doi.org/10.25663/brainlife.app.174.  This App was used specifically for a Replicability Study and has been deprecated.
description: Deprecated App used for a replicability study. Collects per-subject CSV files with false/true positive rates and AUC for multi-LAP and multi-NN tract segmentation (from brainlife.app.174), interpolates and averages the ROC curves across subjects, and plots the mean ROC-AUC curves for one tract. It only works on the output of that specific App.

inputs.description: csv file reporting fdr, tdr and AUC for multi-LAP and multi-NN

outputs.description: PNG plot of the mean ROC curves and AUCs for multi-LAP and multi-NN for the tract.

failure_modes.fix: No image was produced; check that the inputs are the CSV outputs of brainlife.app.174.
